title: Who eats whom: simple food chains
examples: Teacher, where does the energy start in a food chain?
Can you show me an example of a plant eater?
What happens if all the plants disappear?

explain.say: Today you will learn about food chains. A food chain shows who eats what. The energy starts with the Sun.

draw.text: Who eats whom: simple food chains

explain.say: Now look. This is a food web in 3D. Can you see the Sun and the grass? Tap any part to hear about it.

draw.text: Who eats whom: simple food chains

explain.say: Plants use sunlight to make their own food. Plants are called producers.
A herbivore is a plant eater. A rabbit eats grass, so a rabbit is a herbivore.
Animals that eat other animals are carnivores, or meat eaters. An owl is a carnivore.
Here is a food chain. Grass grows with energy from the Sun. A rabbit eats the grass.
Animals eat different foods. Herbivores eat plants. Carnivores eat meat. Omnivores eat both.

faq.q: Why do food chains always start with the sun?
faq.a: The sun provides the energy that makes plants grow. Plants use this energy to create food for everyone else. It is the original source of energy.
asks: Where does the energy come from?

faq.a: Yes. Plants use sunlight to make their own food. This is called photosynthesis.
asks: Do plants make their own food?

faq.q: What is the difference between a plant eater and a meat eater?
faq.a: Plant eaters only eat plants, like rabbits eating grass. Meat eaters only eat other animals, like lions eating meat. They eat different things.

faq.q: Can an animal eat both plants and meat?
faq.a: Yes, some animals eat both plants and meat. These animals are called omnivores. They have a varied diet.
asks: What if an animal eats everything?
Is there a middle group of eaters?

faq.q: Do food chains have to be very long?
faq.a: No, food chains can be short or long. They just show one path of energy moving from one living thing to another. The path can be simple.
asks: How long can a food chain be?

facts: The sun is the main source of energy.
Plants use sunlight to make food.
Meat eaters eat only other animals.

quiz.say: Which living thing comes first in a food chain?
quiz.why: Plants make their own food from sunlight. So they start the chain.

wrong.1: Rabbits eat plants, so plants come before them.
wrong.2: Owls eat other animals, so they come near the end.

quiz.say: An owl eats a mouse. What kind of eater is the owl?
quiz.why: An owl eats other animals, so it is a meat eater, or carnivore.

wrong.0: A plant eater eats only plants, like a rabbit eating grass.
wrong.2: A producer is a plant that makes its own food.

quiz.say: A fox eats berries. It also eats mice. What is the fox?
quiz.why: An omnivore eats both plants and animals.

wrong.0: A herbivore eats only plants, and the fox eats mice too.
wrong.1: A carnivore eats only meat, and the fox eats berries too.
